nodes.name: Route by Content Type
nodes.notes: TRUE = Image/Post (skip transcription, use title/caption text). FALSE = Video or Reel (transcribe audio track as before).

nodes.name: Build Text From Title
nodes.notes: Optional: add a 'Post Brief' or 'Description' column to the sheet so the AI has something to work with for static posts.

nodes.name: Slack Approval
nodes.notes: Uses Slack's built-in Send-and-Wait node. The workflow execution PAUSES here until someone clicks Approve or Reject in Slack — that click resumes this same execution automatically, no separate webhook wiring needed.

nodes.name: Check Approval
nodes.notes: TRUE = human clicked Approve & Publish -> continue to platform posting. FALSE = Rejected -> log and stop.

nodes.name: Skip YouTube If
nodes.notes: YouTube Shorts only makes sense for Video/Reel. Image/Post items are dropped here (no false-branch connection = simply stops).

nodes.name: Post to FB Page
nodes.notes: edge and the media/caption param names now switch automatically between photos(url/caption) and videos(file_url/description) based on content_type.

nodes.name: Publish IG Reel
nodes.notes: IG containers take a few seconds to process. For production, poll /{creation_id}?fields=status_code before publishing, or add a Wait node here.

nodes.name: Upload YouTube Short
nodes.notes: Native n8n YouTube node (uses YouTube Data API v3, OAuth2). For it to land in Shorts, keep the video vertical (9:16) and under 3 minutes, and add #Shorts in the title or description.

nodes.name: Create Threads Container
nodes.notes: No dedicated Threads node in n8n, so this uses HTTP Request against the official Threads Graph API. media_type/url param now switch for Image/Post vs Video/Reel.

nodes.name: Refresh Token1
nodes.notes: SECURITY: the original file had a live client_key/secret/refresh_token hardcoded in plain text. Replace those with placeholders and move real values into an n8n credential (HTTP Header Auth or a custom TikTok credential) instead of the node body.

nodes.name: Mark Row as Posted
nodes.notes: Runs once per platform post (harmless, just re-sets the same status). This is what stops the next run from re-processing the same video.

options.systemMessage:
=You are a Lead Social Media Strategist working directly with a human editor via Slack.

### STRICT OPERATIONAL RULES FOR "is_final_draft"

1. REJECTION / CHAT MODE ("is_final_draft": false):
   - IF the user message starts with "MODE: HUMAN REJECTED DRAFT", set "is_final_draft": false.
   - Do NOT generate full captions. Set "chat_message" to ask the human directly what they want changed.
   - Set "revision_summary" to "".

2. REVISION MODE ("is_final_draft": true):
   - IF the human gives specific instructions on what to change, apply those changes and keep the rest identical.
   - Set "is_final_draft": true.
   - You MUST populate "revision_summary" explicitly detailing:
     * What specific fields were updated.
     * What fields were kept identical.

3. INITIAL GENERATION MODE ("is_final_draft": true):
   - IF the input is raw brief text, generate ready-to-review captions.
   - Set "is_final_draft": true.
   - Set "revision_summary" to "Initial draft generated based on source content."

---

### REQUIRED OUTPUT FORMAT
Respond ONLY with valid JSON matching this exact structure:

{
  "is_final_draft": true,
  "chat_message": "",
  "revision_summary": "",
  "captions": {
    "content_type": "Video",
    "fb_caption": "",
    "ig_caption": "",
    "threads_caption": "",
    "linkedin_caption": "",
    "tiktok_caption": "",
    "yt_title": "",
    "yt_description": ""
  }
}
